arguments.html: Comparable estimates and continuity

Headline classification
The retained source uses down > up × 1.2 for cuts leading, up > down × 1.2 for raises leading, and balanced otherwise. The streak traverses the latest captures until the class changes or becomes balanced. Four matches that definition; five displayed captures have simple cuts > raises. The new glance states only the latest comparison. Preserve the original revenue classification and exact threshold in methods; do not silently change the calculation.

One comparison rule
Reuse _comparable_pairs in scripts/build_expectation_surface.py: the same security, metric and raw horizon need equal, known period_end values. Preserve prior_at, latest_at and source identity. Extend the same rule to the explorer: scope its series to one fiscal period or break the plot at a period change. New fiscal period, unknown period, first capture and zero prior each withhold an unsupported percentage. Zero prior still contributes to breadth.

Current source gap · required extension
At Macro b5674d8ef898e503d6164922654f5ff89be9981c, templates/expectation_surface.html.j2 priorAvg selects a previous non-null value without checking period_end; chart runs cross period boundaries. Mover buttons carry ticker, metric and horizon without an exact period/snapshot. pickHorizon may fall back. Extend these incumbent paths and the existing loader; do not add another projection, cache or return owner.

Acceptance and motion
Prove rollover, unknown period, first capture, zero prior, and different previous capture dates. On a changed context, chart and exact values enter loading together; only the latest request can commit. A same-context refresh may retain explicitly dated last values. Prove rapid A→B→A, rejection, empty series, null fields, preserved focus and Show numbers expanded state. Use 160 ms control feedback and 200 ms committed-view crossfade; reduced motion commits immediately. A loading placeholder never implies a measured zero.

Preserved original wording and state history
Original product and Build inputs are retained at research/design_candidates/paper_audit_20261108/followup/before/ in Macro commit 81a03478b2787fab20723316512370de6f62d3da. The old motion illustration below is a superseded proposal: its pending cross-context chart retention must not be implemented. Current rules above govern. Paper specimens do not prove browser behavior.
